issues.detail: The Vietnamese adds 'nơi con gái của người Ca-na-an, nơi đất mà ta đã dẫn nó đến' (from the daughters of the Canaanites, in the land where I have brought him), which is not present in the Hebrew verse. The Hebrew only says 'If you will not go to my father's house and to my family, and take a wife for my son.'
